data.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?

result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For a small team, I'd recommend **1Password Business** as the best overall password manager.

The most important features for a team aren't just secure password storage. They're\:

- Shared vaults for team logins.
- Individual accounts and permissions.
- Easy onboarding and offboarding.
- Secure sharing of credentials with colleagues.
- Admin controls and activity reporting.
- Support for MFA and passkeys.

Here are the options I'd shortlist.

## Best password managers for small teams

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password**

(Best overall experience)

- Excellent shared vaults and permissions.
- Very user-friendly.
- Strong admin controls and security alerts.
- Great for non-technical teams.

Teams Starter Pack: US\$24.95/month for up to 10 users. Business: US\$8.99/user/month.

[1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business)

---

![The best password managers in 2026 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NzVuMgIchg5mHs-Kr9143cu9YVcLD78U-cfqnnpzpdksR6kB5LPVR6OyqUe0J0PAWilFgVX5RafeZ-AzNa_G6WUPgI8J1U4oAahEfqnQQL2SaxhVwFg9jy1o1kVewXMyq40iQ1cCkpkzpsh_DQntfgs6e3PLRpQFbO3dRcV-HQGbTSkVwYxuDvCJM657Aw6_?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden**

(Best value)

- Open-source foundations.
- Shared collections and team management.
- Audit logs and directory integration.
- Excellent value for money.

Teams: approximately US\$4/user/month, billed annually.

[Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper**

- Strong administrative controls.
- Shared folders and delegated administration.
- Good compliance-oriented features.

Business Starter: approximately US\$2/user/month for 5–10 users.

[Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![The best password managers in 2025 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/S30I88layvxbkaDwXaWP5XnJ7U511ARCXJEcDjYd8i8QoMbXMBiKKYXroCriJ7kBR0oi7lM-NLlyOXMHqaLP4YKGj6rWlLsTvfSS4pKj24h_up7wZjWKu6xYF8rT-_7bc8XbvU4PlaIDiwcj88cnT8GVhbZrDMRuBptQttvTl2oiFqpoAxV9-pe3un--FrSZ?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Proton Pass**

- Privacy-focused approach.
- Secure credential sharing.
- Good option for teams already using Proton services.

[Proton Pass for Business](https://proton.me/business/pass)

Prices above are indicative USD prices, generally based on annual billing, before tax. Confirm current Australian pricing and plan limits before purchasing. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[cybercred.com.au](https://cybercred.com.au/articles/password-managers-compared-for-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[itsecureops.com](https://itsecureops.com/guides/small-business-password-managers/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

I'd narrow it down to two\:

| Your priority | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| Best usability and team experience | 1Password |
| Best security/value balance | Bitwarden |


For a small business, I would personally lean towards 1Password if the budget allows it, particularly if staff aren't especially technical.
